authority: Only manuscript II-VIII, agreed clarifications; R-030/R-033 and existing authority contracts
transaction: One existing SQLite database: ManagerRecord checkpoint, signed state/update history, revoked set, consumed revocation nonces, operations outcome, chained head, service tip. Allocation/base state/entries preserved.
signing: Existing ManagerSigningAdapter with fixed key, role, service/instance and expected public identity; write policy and exact ticket before/after signing; no caller overrides.
commit: Privately sign outside transaction. BEGIN IMMEDIATE revalidates policy, expected ticket, generation/writer, previous checkpoint, operation absence and complete candidate recovery admission. Existing _write performs one COMMIT.
publication: Redacted commit ack. Public epoch-range pages derive only from admitted checkpoint. Committed REVOKED/CURRENT result enqueue under same database writer/fencing lock, no recipient binding or signing.
recovery: External expected HeadTicket mandatory; no automatic refresh/admission. Repeated mutation requires separate retrieval. Current reply cannot be re-enqueued after state changes. Historical updates remain public.
fault_model: 22 integration cases including simulated faults; two real SIGKILL application-barrier cases. No power-loss, SQLite-internal-crash, malicious-owner or coordinated rollback protection claim.
